BiblicalUsage: Ramam is to rise up. Moses and Aaron fell on their faces when God said, 'Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment'; the psalm says, 'The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly'; and Job says the wicked 'are exalted for a little while, but are gone.'
TheologicalSignificance: This tells me that rising up is God's to command: He tells His people to rise out of judgment, He exalts His own right hand, and He cuts down the wicked who exalted themselves.
